description: Check an ApexCharts options object against the data-format rules and known pitfalls (wrong series shape for chart type, radialBar values outside the min/max domain, undefined data points, conflicting tooltip flags, hex colors missing #, etc.). Returns structured issues so the caller can fix them. Returns ok: true when there are no errors (warnings still allowed).

config.description: The ApexCharts options object to validate.

name: apexcharts_validate_config
title: Validate ApexCharts config
